dcterms:description: ViQuAE is a novel dataset consisting of 3,700 questions paired with images, annotated using a semi-automatic method. It is the first KVQAE dataset to cover a wide range of entity types, associated with a knowledge base composed of 1.5 million Wikipedia articles, including texts and images.
dcterms:title: ViQuAE
